summary: Iteration 3 verification for learntolarp.com — Handle Prompt, Sniff The Bot, LARP Test Quiz, and Trending Velocity. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass (total suite unchanged/passing). Verified: (1) POST /entities/generate accepts first_larped_by custom handle (Nirvana → 'Test-Agent'); handle 'admin' (blocklist) and 'a' (too short) are rejected and fall back to LLM-generated Analyst-XX. (2) GET /entities/{slug}/sniff returns 4 questions × 6 archetypes (casual_fan, superfan, new_fan, ragebaiter, fake_fan, veteran) each with 4 answers; second call cached (<3s); unknown slug 404s. (3) GET /entities/{slug}/quiz returns 10 questions each with scenario + 4 options, correct_index NOT exposed to client; cached on second call. (4) POST /entities/{slug}/quiz/grade with [0]*10 for Radiohead returned score=3/10, tier=caught; correct_index distribution across the 10 questions was [0,2,3,0,2,0,1,2,2,1] — proves options are shuffled per question. Verdict tiers (convincing/suspicious/caught) map correctly by percentage. (5) GET /entities?sort=trending&limit=5 returns items with velocity field: [(radiohead,20),(nirvana,4),(the-beatles,1)] and pads with lifetime when thin. Frontend: HandlePromptModal appears when visiting an uncompiled slug, has data-testid handle-input / handle-submit-btn / handle-skip-btn, submit label becomes 'Compile as Playwright-Bot', Skip navigates to queued state. Entity page (/entity/radiohead) shows field-kit-ctas with open-sniff-bot-btn and open-quiz-btn plus 'First larped by // Agent-R05' in stats. Sniff modal opens fast (cached), reveals answers via 'Ask another question' (1→2 exchanges), 6 archetype buttons render, guessing reveals result, streak updates in ltl-sniff-streak localStorage (0 after wrong guess — correct behavior), restart button starts a new round. LARP Quiz modal opens, one scenario at a time, Next disabled until an option picked, all 10 answered → verdict card with big label 'GETTING CAUGHT', score 3/10, expandable Review Your Answers, Copy Verdict + Try Again buttons present. Landing trending grid card shows '22 hits this week' when velocity > 0.

issues: Two 404 asset errors persist in console (favicon/manifest) — carried from iteration 2, non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 995 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting Sniff/Quiz logic into a separate module (/app/backend/minigames.py) for maintainability.

HANDLE_BLOCKLIST uses substring match (`if bad in lower`). This over-blocks legitimate handles containing safe substrings, e.g. 'admin' inside 'admiral'. Acceptable given the rough-by-design intent but note it in docs.

quiz correct_index shuffling in compile_quiz uses random.shuffle — deterministic ordering is not guaranteed across restarts, but since shuffle happens at storage time before the DB insert, that's fine.
Trending velocity pipeline runs an aggregate on db.hits every list call — for higher traffic add an index on {ts:1, slug:1} to keep sub-100ms latency.
record_hit is called on every GET /entities/{slug} and every successful generate — good; no rate-limit on hit inflation from the same client though (potential trend gaming).
SniffBotGame: streak is only stored via localStorage — expected/intentional per spec (local streak only).
HandlePromptModal frontend regex allows spaces but backend sanitize_handle strips them; client replaces spaces with dashes before submit — consistent.
test_credentials: ADMIN_TOKEN=learntolarp-admin-dev-token-change-me (unchanged, not exercised in iter3 tests but present in test file).
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-existing compiled entities (radiohead, the-beatles, nirvana) which already had cached sniff/quiz data. Trending velocity test hit the-radiohead slug 3 additional times to seed velocity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives in /app/backend/tests/{backend_test.py, test_iteration3.py}. Run with `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/ -v -o 'addopts='` (pytest.ini uses xdist which is fine; the -o override disables it if needed). All iteration 1-3 features covered. Sniff/Quiz endpoints trigger LLM (10-30s) on first call per new entity slug — subsequent calls are cached. Radiohead / The Beatles / Nirvana all have cached sniff+quiz. Handle blocklist is substring-based; keep test handles clean of blocklist substrings when testing custom handles.
